programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered 'pests.' But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they're not welcome.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep5
programme.desc: There's strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival.

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1 Ep1
programme.desc: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment.

programme.title: Coastal Africa S1 Ep2
programme.desc: On Africa's east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor Ep1
programme.desc: A veteran pair of osprey return home to a Connecticut saltmarsh. Over one summer they must battle their enemies, withstand the elements, and hunt hundreds and hundreds of fish.

programme.title: Airborne S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings.

programme.title: Airborne S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly and catch a wandering salamander's death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Airborne S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1 Ep3

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1 Ep10
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1 Ep11
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Bluey S3 Ep34

programme.title: Pop Paper City S1 Ep44

programme.title: Dog Loves Books S1 Ep6

programme.title: Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

programme.title: Brooklyn’s Best Pizza Tour
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He’ll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he’ll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

programme.title: BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio’s best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin’s best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin’ beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird but the food is fabulous.

programme.title: Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen.

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don’t you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Top of the Line Steaks
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled chateaubriand with charred broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde dons his Santa hat & holiday garb while grilling up smoked ham & pineapple praline sliders, sweet potatoes with soy maple bacon, eggplant with labneh & cranberries, a holiday mezze plate, and a grilled coquito cocktail.

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It’s always taco night at Chef Dale’s house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: Heavenly Hibachi Bites
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde tries his hand at hibachi by making supreme fried rice with shrimp, chicken, and bacon, pretzel pork dumplings, mushroom noodles, a filet of beef with the famous onion volcano, and washes it down with a melon & mint sake slushy.

programme.title: Over the Top Holiday Cakes
programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays
programme.desc: In this episode, you don’t even need to turn on your oven! From a jaw-dropping cake hack, to fried biscuit donuts, you won’t believe what you can do with pre-made desserts from the supermarket. Mia will show hacks and great tips for any home-baker!

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego

programme.title: Crispy & Creamy Cali-Soul Food
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Keith Corbin is sharing his personal journey through food with his show-stopping, Cali-Soul menu: Black-Eyed Pea Fritters, Cream of Mushroom Mac & Cheese, and his secret technique to making fried chicken with crispy skin.

programme.title: Shrimp Ceviche with Fruit Flavors
programme.desc: Chef Jason Neroni has a knack for working with everyday ingredients in unexpected ways. This menu does just that! Velvety Avocados are Roasted and topped with Green Garlic Mole Verde and Shrimp Ceviche gets elevated with pineapple salsa and peanuts.

programme.title: Grilled Pork with Corn & Greens
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Lauren is showing us how to take your grilling game up to the next level. One element is more delicious than the next. On the menu: her Marinated & Grilled Pork Tenderloin topped with Hazelnut Salsa Macha, Corn Puree, Quick Braised Greens.

programme.title: Enveloped in Sole, Sauce, & Caesar Salad
programme.desc: Chef Shirley Chung combines her experiences of cooking in renowned French and Italian restaurants with her Chinese heritage, to create a one-of-a-kind, out-of-this-world menu with a salad, a fish, and a panna cotta.

programme.title: Corn Cavatelli Cacio e Pepe & Summer Cobbler
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto uses the entire ear of corn to create custom creamy cacio e pepe cavatelli. We’re talking cob, kernel, and husk - and for dessert, he’s making a sweet summery strawberry cobbler that you won’t soon forget.

programme.title: Seaside Scallops with a Salad and a Sweet
programme.desc: Chef Stuart O’Keeffe sears up some scallops with smashed crispy fingerlings and roasted tomatoes. He also dishes up an herbed salad, a light and refreshing vodka cocktail, and a fresh and creamy strawberry parfait.

programme.title: Hot Fried Chicken Sando on A Furikake Bun
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval serves up a hot fried chicken sandwich on a homemade furikake bun with Japanese mayo and southern-style slaw. On the side, he preps deliciously crispy hand-cut fries - dig in to this fried feast!

programme.title: Poolside Shrimp Taco Platter
programme.desc: Chef Angie Lee transports you to Baja, Mexico with her crispy tempura fried Baja shrimp tacos with salsa, black beans, and cilantro cauliflower rice. Corn salad with chipotle dressing adds a good crunch too!

programme.title: Egg Yolk Raviolo with Whipped Ricotta
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto shows us the art of pasta making by creating a gorgeous raviolo. This pasta is filled with egg yolk and fluffy ricotta in a brown butter sauce. A tomato salad and orange blossom cookies finish it all off.

programme.title: Pork Katsu & Spicy Curry
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval makes his version of a Japanese katsu and curry with a breaded and fried pork cutlet and a spicy vegetable curry laced with lemongrass and garlic. On the side, a Hawaiian potato salad made with bacon!

programme.title: Coastal Seafood & Chocolatey Churros
programme.desc: LA Native Chef Angie Lee’s Baja shrimp and rockfish ceviche gets a citrusy twist. Mexican sea bass is served with a colorful corn slaw and spicy grilled pineapple, and fried churros with gooey chocolate are for dessert.

programme.title: Roast Chicken & Bread Salad
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe shows us how to make his perfect lemon & garlic roast chicken. A simple panzanella and burrata salad is up next, followed by his chewy no-bake crispy date cookies, which are to die for.

programme.title: Not Your Mom's Meatballs & Gnocchi
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto is paying homage to his mom’s meatballs, but adding in some mortadella and fennel salame! He’s pairing them with homemade ricotta gnocchetti and roasted carrots. For dessert, a no-churn banana ice cream.

programme.title: Kimchi & Other Korean Classics
programme.desc: This menu is Chef Angie Lee’s love letter to her Korean roots. She’s making a veggie mixed rice bowl called bibimbap complete with cucumber kimchi and a classic seaweed soup. A yuja cha soda drink tops it all off.

programme.title: Irish Crispy Fish & Chips
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe puts a modern twist on fish n’ chips by adding champagne batter, a malt vinegar aioli, and the thrice cooked chips. On the side, smashed minty peas, and a delicious dump cake for dessert.

programme.title: Korean Short Ribs with Pineapple Sauce & Coconut Rice
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval brings backyard grilling fun into the kitchen. Korean short ribs soak in a pineapple huli huli sauce, with a side of coconut jasmine rice and cucumber salad...then black sesame ice cream for the win!

programme.title: Dumplings, Steam Buns, and Dim Sum, Oh My!
programme.desc: In a city with over 60 Michelin star restaurants, one brother will live and dine like a king, while the other will check out the city’s more affordable street food scene.

programme.title: Simplicity vs. Splendor on the Seaside
programme.desc: Soaking in the beauty and elegance of the French Riviera, Marko and Alex are in Nice to enjoy the simplicity and splendor of this seaside city.

programme.title: Keep Austin Weird
programme.desc: In the state capital of Texas, Marko and Alex see what Austin has to offer. An eclectic city known for its music and cuisine, the guys brave the Texas heat and check out what keeps Austin weird.

programme.title: Levels of Luxury in Laos
programme.desc: Sandwiched between Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia, Laos is a destination often overlooked by tourists. Marko and Alex are uncovering the hidden gem of Vientiane, the capital city, to see what goes on in this sleepy town beside the Mekong River.

programme.title: The Gainful Grace of Geneva
programme.desc: Marko and Alex find themselves in the prosperous and pristine city of Geneva, Switzerland. A city nestled alongside a beautiful glacier-fed lake, the guys will explore the riches Geneva has to offer.

programme.title: The Thriving Traditions of Taipei
programme.desc: ​Welcome to the buzzing capital of Taiwan. A rich blend of cultures, old meets new in this thriving metropolis of Taipei. Marko and Alex eat their way through the city, experiencing some unique traditions along the way.

programme.title: The Lion's Share of Lyon
programme.desc: Marko and Alex head to Lyon, France, a city known for its gastronomy and endless history.

programme.title: Oceanside in Okinawa
programme.desc: Ocean breeze, turquoise waters and a whole lot of amazing cuisine. Marko and Alex are soaking up that island life in Okinawa, Japan and learning what makes it so unique.

programme.title: Genoa From Above and Below
programme.desc: In Genoa, the brothers cruise the streets, while one of them gets a taste for the lavish lifestyle of Italy's Northwestern port. They take in all the views: heads in the clouds on a high-flying funicular, and just above water at the local aquarium.

programme.title: The L.A. Lifestyle
programme.desc: Green juice, avocado toast, and surfers galore. Marko and Alex are back home in Los Angeles to explore their town, staycation style. From downtown to the beach, the guys do everything fun under the sun in the city of angels.

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Origins to Originals
programme.desc: From roast chicken to smash burgers to hot sauce, Stephanie Izard meets three different chefs putting their own California-inspired spin on food from their heritage by remixing traditional recipes that center local, fresh ingredients.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Home Cooking
programme.desc: From a homerun Greek dinner party series to a backyard that’s become a gourmet deli to a Burmese pop up running out of an apartment kitchen, Stephanie Izard meets cooks finding ingenious ways to serve mouth-watering food out of their houses.

programme.title: Comfort Foods

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord

programme.title: Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep17
programme.desc: Dr Aish berasa tidak selesa pabila Dr Erin cuba untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut tentang masa silamnya. Mika terkenangkan arwah ibunya apabila bertemu dengan seorang pesakit wanita yang sudah berumur.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep18
programme.desc: Mika mula cemburu apabila melihat Oya rapat dengan Dr Aish. Seorang pemuda tampan mula mendekati Dr Erin. Harun mengusulkan sesuatu kepada Pian untuk merawati masalahnya itu.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep19
programme.desc: Ramai yang terkejut bila mengetahu Dr Aish mahu berhenti kerja secara tiba-tiba. Oya diteguri kerana tidak focus di dalam kuliah. Kerana mash cemburu, Mika mula tidak endahkan Oya.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep20
programme.desc: Japor mula merancang untuk mencari kenalan gadis yang baru. Mika meminta bantuan Japor untuk memikat wanita. Mika resah kerana belum berjaya mendapatkan pekerjaan.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep16
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep17
programme.desc: Sikap prihatin dan baik Rohana terhadap Ainnura akhirnya terbongkar apabila tujuan Rohana merestui hasrat Fariz untuk megahwini Ainnura hanyalah semata-mata untuk membalas dendam pada Ainnura. Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep18
programme.desc: Rohana sengaja menyeksa fizikal dan mental Ainnura. Fazira melihat apa yang dilakukan oleh Rohana terhadap Ainnura lalu mendesak Ainnura dan Fariz keluar dari rumah tersebut. Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep19
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep20
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep5
programme.desc: Pita VHS itu adalah rakaman video Cikgu Mus dan Cikgu Aini Ketika mereka jadi pelajar pada tahun 1998. Kedua-duanya amat akrab dan sering membuat kerenah di sekolah, sehinggalah kemunculan Assuntha Devi.

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep6
programme.desc: Mal terus berusaha menyakat Chelsea. Tapi Adam sudah semakin rapat dengan Chelsea. Chelsea mula sedar bergaduh dengan Mal kerja sia-sia. Tapi Mal tak peduli.

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep7
programme.desc: Konflik Mal dan Cikgu Aini Kembali. Mal ungkit tentang rakaman pita VHS. Itu membuatkan Mal Kembali sedar apa dia lakukan pada Chelsea adalah kerja sia-sia. Mal mula untuk meminta maaf pada semua orang.

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep8
programme.desc: Pita VHS Cikgu Aini hilang! Mal kumpukan kawan-kawannya untuk cari siapa yang ambil pita VHS itu. Mereka tak mahu rahsia Cikgu Aini diketahui oleh cikgu dan pelajar sekolah itu!

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep1
programme.desc: Mal dituduh membuat onar pada kereta Cikgu Annuar. Adam dan Alya membantu Mal untuk membersihkan namanya sebelum dia digantung sekolah. Mal mahu tahu siapakah yang membuat fitnah padanya.

programme.title: SMK S5 Ep2
programme.desc: Kemunculan ‘Miss A’ di internet yang cuba menjatuhkan reputasi Mal membuatkan dia paranoid. Dia cuba siasat semua pelajar dengan nama bermula huruf A, termasuklah Arif dan Adam.

programme.title: FYP: Famili Yang Popular S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Nek Na & Bonda caridaun herba di pasar untuk buat ubat Zahrin. Dalam masa sama Bonda & anak-anak masih sibuk dengan dunia media sosial. Ketika ‘LIVE’, bonda tersentak dengan komen seseorang.

programme.title: FYP: Famili Yang Popular S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ketika makan malam, Bonda & anak-anak sibuk bertekak mengenai dunia media sosial sehingga menyebabkan Zahrin stress dan meninggikan suara pada keluarganya dimana pada ketika itu Bonda sedang ‘LIVE’.

programme.title: FYP: Famili Yang Popular S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Kak Herli, Abang Irlan dan Bonda terkejut apabila mereka mendapat kecaman netizen disebabkan insiden Zahrin marah ketika ‘LIVE’.

programme.title: FYP: Famili Yang Popular S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Jiran mereka, Maimun turut berangan untuk menyertai anugerah FYP. Dalam masa yang sama, Bonda mengamuk apabila dapat tahu Irlan sedang hanyut dilamun cinta dengan peminatnya, Natrah.

programme.title: FYP: Famili Yang Popular S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Zahrin diberhentikan kerja oleh bosnya. Maimun pula masih berusaha untuk jadi influencer dan cuba buat bisnes online tetapi gagal kerana tidak berbakat. Bonda terkejut Zahrin menghidap sakit kanser.

programme.title: Fam I Love You S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Keluarga Shahir cuba membiasakan diri dengan kehadiran Nenek dan Atuk di rumah.

programme.title: Fam I Love You S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Nenek membantu Qalisha untuk mengejar impiannya menjadi influencer berjaya

programme.title: Fam I Love You S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Shahir dan Marrisa akhirnya kantoi. Keluarga Shahir sudah tahu Shahir kini beekrja sebagai rider GoBarang

programme.title: Fam I Love You S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Shahir jatuh sakit dan Marrisa terpaksa menggantikan Shahir sebagai kakak GoBarang! Atuk dan Nenek pula menggambil alih tugasan Marrisa di rumah

programme.title: Fam I Love You S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Qalisha, Nenek, Iman dan Marrisa sepakat untuk membantu Shahir dengan melakukan "part time".

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: Sometimes, all that it takes is a shift underfoot…. Desperate Hours looks at major geological disasters including avalanches in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Nepal, Peru, and France. It also looks at geological landslides in the Philippines, India and Columbia and an enormous sinkhole that consumed a pond in Bosnia. programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: When humans are a serious danger to themselves ... Desperate Hours looks at nuclear and industrial disasters including the Fukushima Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Japan, the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Ukraine, the Deepwater Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the Savar Plaza disaster in Bangladesh, and the Bhopal Gas disaster in India. When a catastrophic event strikes a nuclear power facility the resulting disaster can be, literally, off the scale and last for decades.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E05 - Prospectors
programme.desc: From collecting samples at old mines, to hiking the high country with metal detectors, Tom and Kael Massie are looking for signs of gold.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E06 - Golden Glaciers and Danger
programme.desc: Tom and Kael Massie decide to enter a natural glacier cave, leading to a string of mishaps and terrifying collapse of the glaciers mouth, but they emerge unscathed and with a prize.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E15 - Log Jam
programme.desc: Dangerous log jams on the Flathead River threaten unprepared boaters and tubers.

programme.desc: A slew of un-licensed anglers catch the attention of Game Wardens.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.desc: Everybody loves a great western. Except Larry. Terry gets Larry to test more scenes from classic western movies.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: Seafaring is a dangerous business indeed…… Desperate Hours looks at major disasters on the high seas including the Sewol Ferry disaster in South Korea, the Ferry Estonia in the Baltic Sea, the sinking of the Titanic, the Exxon Valdez in Prince William Sound Alaska, the Express Samina in Portes Islets, pirates attacking the Maersk Alabama and Seabourn Spirit, and the Costa Concordia in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller…… Airplane crashes are most people’s worst nightmares. programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigating a string of murdered lions, Ivan gets to the very heart of an ancient conflict between humans and lions. The outcome will test Ivan's own core values about cultural

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E07 - Slaying the Port Labelle Monster
programme.desc: Manny tangles with a monster hog in the dense woods of Port Labelle.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E08 - Save a Watermelon Kill a Boar Part 1
programme.desc: Manny tracks down a boar raiding watermelon fields in southwestern Florida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E09 - Save a Watermelon Kill a Boar Part 2
programme.desc: After slaying a monster boar, Manny heads back into the forest and goes toe to toe with an even bigger boar.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E10 - How to Stop a Charging Wild Boar
programme.desc: In this episode of Savage Wild, we're headed into the palmettos with Full Rut Outfitters in search of wild boar.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E07 - Naturally Majestic
programme.desc: Follow in the footsteps of Indiana Jones. In this episode of Miracles of Nature we visit the wonders of the Gobi Desert which is one of the oldest deserts in the world, and then the contrasting lush, green hillsides of northern Mongolian. From there we travel 5000 kilometres to the south east to Jordan and the Dead Sea.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw
programme.desc: This episode begins in Costa Rica, in an amazing rain forest. Here they make delicious chocolate out of cocoa beans. Mother Nature is at her magnificent best – showcasing hundreds of plant and animal species. And then to Kenya where green monkeys will be our tour-guides in the Lost City of Gedi plus a closer look at the wildlife which lives in very close proximity to the bustling streets of Nairobi.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Iceland: home to volcanic lakes and hot springs and mono-chromatic vistas. And then to Laos in South East Asia with its lush jungles, underground caves and water buffalo along the Mekong River.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent
programme.desc: Explore the unspoilt mountains of Lapland and on to the pristine Swiss Alps. In contrast we then travel to Champagne Province in France - home of the finest wines in the world. Finally, Gibraltar beckons with its long history and strange mysterious caves.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E02 - Colorado Mule Deer
programme.desc: Laramy rides the high lonesome in search of mule deer. Learn Laramy's mountain man techniques to stalk up close to a big mule deer buck.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E03 - Alaska Caribou
programme.desc: Deep into unexplored territory, Laramy hunts the Alaskan frontier in search of caribou. But with a hungry grizzly on his trail, will his single-shot Hawken rifle be enough to protect him?

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E04 - Colorado Elk
programme.desc: Elk calls echo through the mountains where Laramy is hunting. As night falls, Laramy gets within shooting range of a huge Elk.
